title: AGI ALPHA FLYWHEEL: From Completed Work to Compounding Capability
status: pre-execution protocol; frozen by freeze.json before primary execution
scope: Credential-free source extension of the released createWorkbench(adapters) SDK; no native signed Journal, operating daemon, provider call, contract execution, settlement or production authority.
experimental_unit: one complete six-generation stream; eight paired procedurally generated streams, not 288 independent documents
primary_endpoint: Number of the 36 registered terminal tasks whose output is within the fixed clause cap, contains no unsupported selected clause, and attains the exact maximum feasible supported weight, before cumulative standardized structural work exceeds 500000 units. Unexecuted tasks count zero.
task_family: Synthetic annotated prerequisite-preserving source summaries; useful computational selection procedure, with source truth and reader benefit explicitly unmeasured.

epochs.requirement: Independent clauses ordered by weight; simple incumbent can win.
Permuted independent clauses; weighting can help.
Random acyclic prerequisites with changed importance and order.
New prerequisite graph and tighter output cap.
Return to independent clauses; a specialized retained method can avoid broad search.
New dependency graph and one-clause limit; stale empirical suitability can fail.

task_custody: Finite task bytes generated and hashed before execution. No primary result inspected before freeze. Author knows generator; same-session custody and synthetic distributions do not establish external blinding or representative sampling.

arms.flywheel: Retain up to two exact typed method artifacts. Inspect eligible incumbent on two development documents using the full shipped comparison. If it is supported and exactly optimal on both, reuse its original digest and skip new method enumeration. Otherwise execute all four supplied methods, select highest supported weight then lower declared development work, qualify on two fresh documents, retain or reject. Recheck each terminal output.
arms.cache: Identical information, tools, grammar, cached artifacts, development search, retrieval, adaptation, validation and retention policy as flywheel. Strong conventional workflow; equal logical results are expected by construction, not evidence of unique intelligence.
arms.frozen: Same runtime with initial lead-order selector and no newly acquired method artifact. Secondary intervention comparator, not the strongest baseline.
arms.expert: Prewritten analytical workflow selects weighted method when visible graph has no edges, exact graph method otherwise. It receives no future labels. It is an authored expert-workflow reference; a measured human expert construction study was not conducted and its labor cost is unknown.

construction_and_qualification: Allowed finite method grammar: lead-order, weighted-without-dependencies, audit-after-draft, dependency-graph-before-compression. Candidate criteria fixed before generation. Qualification requires no unsupported selected clause and exact optimal structural weight on both fresh qualification documents; it also cannot reduce their total score relative to incumbent. Failed candidate retains incumbent; no current proof or production permission is granted.
retention: At most two active typed method artifacts; least recently used retirement with deterministic digest tie-break. Entire history and retirement tombstones retained and measured. No artificial expiry of broadly valid algorithms. Actual loaded-source hash change retires stale artifact and requires new comparison; evidence scope remains empirical. Imported activeProof and activeAuthority always empty.
cost_unit: Standardized structural work proxy, not CPU instructions, FLOPs, energy, seconds or money. Every dispatched operation is additionally covered by measured wall/CPU time; all retained output bytes are measured. Human/model-assisted authoring, setup labor and economic opportunity cost remain unknown rather than zero. The admitted proxy budget is not a hard OS CPU limit. The existing workbench also applies a60second elapsed ceiling at bounded checkpoints; validation/hashing can occur between proxy charges.

cost_rules.released_runComparison: n*2^n + sum(C(n,i),i=0..k)*(n+e+1) + 5*n + 2*e. Explicitly charges all mask/claim visits and all-five-method evaluation overhead, using actual input n, edges e and cap k. This fixed accounting model is not an instruction trace.
cost_rules.single_method: Actual instrumented mask/claim visits, sort comparisons, structural-evaluation proxy n+e+1 per call, audit prerequisite/fill checks n+e per call.
cost_rules.retention_and_maintenance: Actual KiB blocks read/serialized/hashed plus active capability inspections; routing n+e+number of retained artifacts.
cost_rules.runtime: One SDK invocation unit plus measured full process wall/CPU and file bytes; compiler and hash instruction counts are not separately calibrated.

stopping: Fixed six-epoch stream, global operator STOP, expired local research permit, source mismatch or next cost reservation exceeding cumulative budget. No automatic budget increase. WAIT means no currently due permitted work; stopped process is not a persistent service.
ablations: After primary freeze/run use only stream0 predeclared tasks. (1) Remove selector component and force initial lead method; (2) construct separately digested but semantically identical typed recipe and execute it; these test selector necessity/replacement, not archive economics. (3) Re-run whole stream0 with the identical flywheel policy and500000 budget but clear retained=[] before every epoch, allowing full candidate reconstruction/requalification and charging it. Compare cumulative cost/coverage to retained stream. Charge all interventions separately and never feed outcomes into primary selection.
faults: lost acknowledgement after immutable pack commit
rollback to prior exact accepted recipe
load: Separate non-primary deterministic workloads at 1, 2 and 4 actual Node worker processes, 16 total epoch tasks per scenario; report throughput, p50/p95 task latency, source-bound result quality, storage and interventions. No extrapolation to production scale.
analysis: Report each paired complete-stream outcome, aggregate qualified counts and total costs, paired stream differences and range. Exact arithmetic for finite outputs. No document-level iid standard errors, unique-intelligence claim, commercial growth claim or superiority presumption.
negative_scope_challenge: An evaluator-only annotation-omission fixture changes true prerequisite semantics while the submitted graph omits that edge. Report whether the local structural checker accepts a result invalid under the hidden graph. This is excluded from primary structural endpoint and preserves model-invalidity failure.
design_history: 50000 units initially proposed before code execution, increased to500000 from static all-five-comparator/mask complexity before primary generation or outcomes; lower points retained as secondary descriptive projections.

Excluded development seed101 exercised initial all-search design. Method review found that unconditional enumeration made retained-asset benefit weak; before primary tasks were generated, identical incumbent-adequacy/skip-search rule was added to both flywheel and conventional cache.
Method review corrected budget terminal labels and added independently recomputed capability commitments while preserving exact digest on reuse.

Pre-freeze review added real loaded-source verification, self-consistent task/retention binding, exact rejected-result restart, actual prior-recipe reuse, and archive-cleared reconstruction counterfactual. Recovery validates by recomputing deterministic semantics; this is recorded extra verification work, not exactly-once CPU.
